name: claude-skills
description: Personal skills plus the Parking Lot, Session Files, and HTML Canvas canvas extensions for the GitHub Copilot app. Copilot-only marketplace manifest; Claude Code reads .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.

plugins.name: claude-skills
plugins.description: Personal Claude Code skills: skill-creator, plugin-creator, forge, mcp-toggle, plugin-updater, fresh-start, dotfiles-sync, devbox-monitor, devbox-report, grill-me, handoff, skill-eval, judgment-evidence, change-walkthrough, skill-distill.

plugins.name: parking-lot
plugins.description: Parking Lot: a per-session backlog canvas for the GitHub Copilot app. Park ideas for later; the agent sees them each turn but only acts when asked.

plugins.name: session-files
plugins.description: Session Files: a canvas for the GitHub Copilot app that browses and previews the files in the current session's folder (artifacts, research, checkpoints).

plugins.name: html-canvas
plugins.description: HTML Canvas: a canvas for the GitHub Copilot app that lets the agent render HTML directly (mockups, explainers, interactive widgets) with in-panel history, and lets the page send messages back to the agent.
